svg.title: How linear assignment is solved, step by step
svg.desc: Animation of the shortest augmenting path method on a 3 by 3 cost matrix. Each worker in turn reads its row, picks its cheapest cost, and if that task is locked by another worker, prices are raised along an alternating path until a free task becomes tight. The final matching has total cost 11 and the prices certify that it is optimal.
svg.text: Solving it, one worker at a time
Shortest augmenting paths with prices: u for every worker, v for every task. An edge is tight when cost − u − v = 0.

g.text: Every worker and every task starts

at a time, and keep a matching that
